messages.subject: New life history hindcaster Shiny apps
messages.subject_clean: New life history hindcaster Shiny apps
messages.body_plain:
Dear NicheMapR users,
I recently added three new Shiny apps that integrate the microclimate, ectotherm and DEB models:
Global Ectotherm Life History Hindcaster <http://bioforecasts.science.unimelb.edu.au/ecto_deb_ncep/> - driven by microclimatic conditions any time from 1949 to last month.
Australian Ectotherm Life History Hindcaster <http://bioforecasts.science.unimelb.edu.au/ecto_deb_oz/> - driven by microclimatic conditions any time from 1889 to yesterday.
USA Ectotherm Life History Hindcaster <http://bioforecasts.science.unimelb.edu.au/ecto_deb_usa/> - driven by microclimatic conditions any time from 1980 to yesterday.
You can choose from any of the ~6000 species with DEB parameters in the AmP collection and simulate their life histories from a given starting date and stage. Let me know if you come across any issues.
All the best,
Mike
